description:
Performance tuning and debugging for DirectX 12 games on Windows


Today we released PIX 2611.19 which can be downloaded here. This release includes everything in the previous 2610.28 release, plus the bug fixes and improvements listed below.
Thank you to everyone who reported issues and suggestions to us. Please keep them coming! The best ways to contact us are via the DirectX Discord and via the Send Feedback buttons in PIX.
GPU Captures
- Various performance improvements when using Tiled Resources
  - Including fixing severe frame rate drops in some scenarios
- Raytracing improvements
  - Greatly reduce GPU capture time and memory usage in applications with many raytracing acceleration structures
  - Fix stalls in application Release() calls during GPU capture of raytracing applications
- Shader Debugger: fix crash when debugging a Dispatch that uses a pipeline state stream PSO
- GPU Counters
  - Fix plugin counter columns showing the wrong counter name after a plugin update
  - Fix engine crash when a GPU plugin fails during counter collection
- VS Output: fix crash when getting VS output for draws inside an outstanding query
- Texture Viewer: show YUV textures (NV12, P010, AYUV, Y410 etc.) as RGB instead of luma only
- Fix debug layer warning during capture caused by the initial state of an internal PIX buffer
- Fix crash when replaying DXBC captures on GPUs that require DXIL conversion
- Timeline: color GPU wait events orange to make them easier to spot
- Custom Visualizers: fix occasional crash when a visualizer includes another file
Shader Explorer
- Use the offline compiler installed with your driver for live profiling, so profiling still works when PIX’s bundled compiler doesn’t match the driver
- Support hex input in pipeline state fields
Timing Captures
- Much faster opening of large captures with GPU timing data
- Fix missing resources when the D3D runtime reuses an object’s address
- Fix GPU timeline ordering of command lists with identical start times
Misc
- Fix black title-bar tabs on systems that use a decimal comma (e.g. French, Polish, German)
- Fix vague errors (e.g. “0x8ABC0001”) shown instead of actionable errors (e.g. Developer Mode message)
- System Monitor: fix race condition that could cause some counters to never appear
- DirectX Dump Files: update NVIDIA plugin to fix incorrect memory access types reported for page faults
- Remote PC: fix crash when connecting to a remote PC from ARM64 PIX
- Text Editor: add an option to turn off highlighting of word occurrences
